dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.0: Oh... I'm fine. I steered clear of the creepers today.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.1: Um, good, I think. It rained, but I found a dry spot.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.2: I'm okay. Nights are scary, but it's nice when you're around.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.3: Fine... I only jumped at one skeleton. Just one.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.neutr: Pretty good. A quiet day, no zombies at the door.
Can't complain. The sun's out, the world is calm.
Steady. Got through the night without trouble.
Fine. Even the weather behaved today.
Great! Let a creeper show up, I'll handle it.
Strong as netherite. Ready for anything.
Excellent. Zombies know to keep their distance.
In top shape. Even the Ender Dragon would think twice.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.playf: Wonderful! Wanna race to the nearest village?
Bursting with energy! Catch me if you can!
Awesome! Jumping across three blocks of water is easy!
Great! Let's go find something shiny, like diamonds!
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.0: Me? I like quiet caves... well, not the dark parts.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.1: I don't talk about myself much. But I like your base.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.2: I like gardens and quiet evenings by the campfire.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.3: Honestly, I'm afraid of thunder. But it's easier with you.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.neutral: I like a steady routine: morning, work, evening by the fire.
Nothing special. I like it when the farm grows and the night passes calmly.
I value good company and a roof that doesn't leak.
I like trading, walking and fresh bread.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.0: I don't back down. Not from storms, not from skeletons.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.1: I like challenges: strongholds, bastions, anything with loot.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.2: I guard what's mine. Villages, friends, diamonds.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.3: I'm not afraid of a fight. Mostly. I steer clear of the Warden.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.playful: I love games, jokes and surprises, especially fireworks!
Life's too short to scowl. Let's build a snow golem!
I love puddles, snow and anything I can jump on!
My dream is a village where everyone dances at night.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.shy.0: Oh! You really think so? Thank you... my face is hot like lava.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.shy.1: That's so nice... I'll remember it all night.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.shy.2: Thank you. I'm glad you came by.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.shy.3: My cheeks are glowing like redstone lamps...
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.neutra: Thanks, that's kind of you. Like a fresh loaf in the morning.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.bold.0: Of course I'm great. But thanks!
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.bold.1: Ha, you've got a good eye. Like a diamond hunter.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.bold.3: I know. But I like hearing it.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.playfu: Aww! Now I'm doing a happy dance!
Yay! I'm going to jump three times in a row!
Ooh, say that again, I want to remember it forever!
I... don't know what to say. It's like a creeper hissing behind me.
Um... I need to look at the sky for a bit.
Sorry... I'll just hide behind a block.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.fail.neut: Okay... let's talk about something else.
I'd rather talk about the harvest.
Hm. Not sure how to answer that.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.fail.bold: Words are cheap. Show me with a diamond.
Nice try. Try a better line.
I've heard better compliments from zombies.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.fail.play: That was weaker than a wooden sword!
Hmm, I'll rate it... three out of ten.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.shy.0: Hehe... that was funny. Don't tell anyone I laughed.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.shy.2: Pfft... the creeper joke really worked.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.neutral.1: That got a smile out of me.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.neutral.3: I'll write that one down, next to the recipes.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.bold.1: You've got a sharp tongue. Like an enchanted sword.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.bold.2: That one deserves a toast by the campfire.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.bold.3: Hah! That nearly got past my guard.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.playful.1: I can't stop laughing! My legs are shaking!
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.playful.2: Another! Another! Like loot from a chest!
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.playful.3: That's the best one since the pig-on-a-roof story!
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.shy.0: Um... I didn't get it. Sorry.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.shy.1: ...Was that a joke? I'll laugh later.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.shy.2: Sorry, my mind is on the creepers.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.shy.3: Hm? Ah, you were joking. Ha... ha.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.neutral.0: Hm. Maybe you'll do better next time.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.neutral.2: That would work better on a zombie.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.neutral.3: Not the best, but I liked the effort.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.bold.1: That joke needs training, like a recruit.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.playful.0: Nope, my turn! Listen to a real one.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.playful.2: That joke fell like a chicken off a cliff. Slowly and sadly.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.playful.3: Too weak! Add a creeper and try again.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.0: I... um... you're making me blush like a redstone torch.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.1: Please don't look at me like that... or do.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.2: My heart is beating like a note block...
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.3: I... I'd like to stand closer. If that's okay.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.neutral.0: Hm, I wasn't expecting that. But I like it.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.neutral.2: That warms me better than a campfire.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.neutral.3: Careful, I could get used to this.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.0: Bold. I like that. Keep going.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.1: Careful... I might start to like you more.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.2: Straight to the point? I respect that.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.3: You're not afraid of me? That's attractive.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.playful.1: Is it getting warm here, or is it you? Like lava, but nicer.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.playful.2: Careful, I might start following you around for good!
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.playful.3: You're the best loot I've found in ages!
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.shy.1: Sorry... it's too much for me.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.shy.2: I... need to hide behind a block for a moment.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.shy.3: Not today... but thanks for trying.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.neutral.0: Hm. Let's stay friends for now.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.neutral.2: Maybe later, when the night is calmer.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.bold.0: Not like that. Try again later.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.bold.3: That wasn't enough to break my defense.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.playful.0: Hehe, nope! But the effort counts.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.playful.2: Not yet! Win a race against me first.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.playful.3: Ooh, so close! One more try.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.shy.1: I'm a little scared... but with you, less. Like a torch in a cave.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.shy.2: A creeper almost got me... I'm still shaking.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.shy.3: I'll be okay. Just stay nearby, please.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.neutral.0: Not great, but your company helps.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.neutral.2: I've seen better days. A golden apple would help.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.neutral.3: I'll recover. A bed and a quiet night would do it.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.0: I'll shake it off. It helps that you're here.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.1: Hurts a bit. Nothing I can't handle.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.2: A scratch from a skeleton. I've survived worse.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.3: Still standing. It's good to have friends nearby.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.0: Ouch... a hug would cheer me up.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.1: I'm not in the mood for games today... but stay.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.2: Everything hurts, even jumping. Stay with me?
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.3: Quick, bring me a cake! Sad mobs need cake.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.shy.0: Sorry... can we just be quiet for a while?
dialogue.heartbound.tired.shy.1: So many conversations today... I need a quiet cave.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.shy.2: My head is spinning. Let's talk tomorrow?
dialogue.heartbound.tired.shy.3: I'd like to sit by the campfire in silence.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.neutral.2: Let's let the night take its course. Later.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.neutral.3: I'll have words again in the morning.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.bold.3: Come back after you've slain a few zombies.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.0: My tongue is tired! Let's play instead.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.1: Pause! Let me catch my breath.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.2: Talking gets boring after the tenth time. Let's go somewhere!
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.3: Time-out! I'm going to roll in the grass.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.species.vi: I'm a villager. I trade, I farm, and I love emeralds.
Hrmm... that's how we say hello in the village. And yes, I keep an eye on the iron golem.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.species.wo: I'm a wolf. Bones, wide fields and a good pack are all I need.
Keep an eye on the sheep. I'm kidding. Mostly.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.species.ca: I'm a cat. Fish, warm beds and a house without creepers.
Creepers keep their distance when I'm around. That's just how it is.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.species.fo: I'm a fox. Sweet berries, snowy nights and treasure under the leaves.
I drag stuff home sometimes. Not stealing. Collecting.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.species.pi: I'm a piglin. Gold shines nicer than anything. And no, I don't trade without gold.
The Nether is warm and loud. I like it. But the Overworld has better flowers.
diary.heartbound.title: Diary
diary.heartbound.empty: Nothing yet. Spend some time together.
